sessions.phase_label: Scope definition, repository onboarding, and implementation planning

requirements.title: Veyra AI Provider Constraint
requirements.definition: Use the existing Veyra AI integration for the platform's AI reasoning, retrieval, and image-generation features while excluding OpenAI from the production implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the independently changeable provider and cost constraint; individual mood-board, retrieval, shopping-link, and selfie behaviors remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: AI-Generated Fashion Mood Boards
requirements.definition: Allow users to prompt the Styling Agent to generate complete fashion mood boards through Veyra AI and present the generated result in the existing interface.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the generated mood-board behavior as one end-to-end capability; provider selection, general web retrieval, and selfie styling can change independently.

requirements.title: Expanded Fashion Source Retrieval
requirements.definition: Expand the range of fashion sources retrieved from the web by the existing agent.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source coverage and retrieval breadth; returning useful shopping links is a separate output behavior that can be modified or tested independently.

requirements.title: Improved Shopping Link Results
requirements.definition: Improve the quantity and usefulness of shopping links returned by the Styling Agent.
requirements.boundary_note: Shopping-link output has its own expected result and can fail or be improved independently of general fashion-source retrieval.

requirements.title: Selfie Styling Capability Evaluation
requirements.definition: Test selfie-based fashion image generation through the backend using Veyra AI and provide the generated results for client review before deciding whether to build the complete production feature.
requirements.boundary_note: The independently requested deliverable is the backend evaluation and its results; a full production selfie-styling feature remains conditional and is not merged into this Requirement.

requirements.title: Per-Account AI Usage Ledger
requirements.definition: Record Veyra AI consumption in Supabase by user account, agent, and prompt type, including token usage and estimated cost sufficient to measure consumption for monetization.
requirements.boundary_note: User, agent, prompt type, token count, and estimated cost are attributes of one usage-recording mechanism; credit balances, subscription tiers, and Stripe payment processing remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Credit-Based Usage System
requirements.definition: Convert measured AI consumption into an account-level credit system that can constrain or account for feature usage.
requirements.boundary_note: Credit accounting is independently operable from raw usage measurement, subscription tier definitions, and Stripe billing.

requirements.title: Usage-Limited Subscription Tiers
requirements.definition: Provide multiple subscription tiers with prompt or usage limits derived from measured Veyra AI consumption.
requirements.boundary_note: Tier definitions and usage limits form one pricing mechanism; the usage ledger supplies measurements, while Stripe independently handles payment processing.

requirements.title: Stripe Subscription Payments
requirements.definition: Integrate Stripe to collect payments for the platform's subscription plans after usage measurements and tier definitions are prepared.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers external payment processing only; usage measurement, credit accounting, and subscription-limit rules have independent state and implementation paths.

requirements.title: Google Analytics 4 Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate Google Analytics 4 tracking into the platform.
requirements.boundary_note: GA4 is an independently deployable and verifiable analytics provider and is therefore separate from Clarity and affiliate-attribution tooling.

requirements.title: Microsoft Clarity Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate Microsoft Clarity behavior analytics into the platform.
requirements.boundary_note: Clarity has a distinct integration and runtime verification path from GA4 and the additional attribution tools.

requirements.title: Affiliate and Campaign Attribution Tracking
requirements.definition: Integrate two or three additional analytics or attribution tools for affiliate marketing and campaign tracking.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested attribution-tool set is one business mechanism, but its providers are still unspecified; GA4 and Clarity are named integrations with separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Showroom and Concierge Usability
requirements.definition: Improve the showroom-to-concierge experience so users and investors can quickly understand what Lumen does and navigate into the agent functionality.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the cross-surface comprehension and navigation flow; Styling Agent capabilities and client-supplied copy edits remain independently changeable.

requirements.title: Front-End Copy Updates
requirements.definition: Apply the small client-supplied text and copy changes to the platform front end.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the concrete copy-edit obligation; exact text is pending, and it is separate from broader navigation or usability behavior.

requirements.title: Shopline App Store Content Widget
requirements.definition: Deliver a Shopline App Store widget that retrieves and presents content from the existing Lumen platform without building a separate AI system or new web scraper.
requirements.boundary_note: OAuth, Shopline APIs, publishing, and compliance webhooks are currently implementation aspects of one widget mechanism; the missing one-pager may later justify more detailed Requirement boundaries.

requirements.title: Legacy Backend Repository Cleanup
requirements.definition: Delete obsolete backend versions from the project's repository set when repository modification is authorized.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a one-off executable repository-cleanup obligation; the temporary restriction on making changes is represented by the separate repository-isolation Requirement and its lifecycle evidence.

requirements.title: Repository Change Isolation
requirements.definition: Keep development changes isolated to the target MVP repositories and dedicated branches, leaving unrelated repositories unchanged.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers where current development changes may occur; it does not erase the separately stated future cleanup of obsolete backend versions.

unresolved_candidates.description: A complete production selfie-styling feature is conditional on the backend evaluation results. Current evidence clearly establishes the evaluation deliverable but does not yet authorize full production implementation.
The affiliate and campaign attribution requirement calls for two or three additional tools, but the specific providers and whether they require separate Requirement atoms remain unspecified.

Detailed Shopline widget behavior is expected in a separate one-pager. Current evidence supports one widget Requirement but is insufficient to split OAuth, content publishing, product APIs, and compliance webhooks into independent product behaviors.

The freelancer states that Stripe can be deferred, but no supplied client message clearly accepts that lifecycle change. Event extraction should not treat message 83 alone as an authoritative deferral.
